python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
import importlib.abc
import importlib.machinery
import importlib.util
import sys
import zipimport
from pathlib import Path
from jinja2 import Environment, PackageLoader
import hashlib
import jinja2
from jinja2 import loaders
print("actual_package:", jinja2.__file__)
print("actual_loaders_sha256:", hashlib.sha256(Path(loaders.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert Path(jinja2.__file__).resolve() == Path("src/jinja2/__init__.py").resolve()

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("tests").resolve()))
class ImportHook(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder, importlib.abc.Loader):
    def find_spec(self, name, path=None, target=None):
        if name != "res":
            return None
        spec = importlib.machinery.PathFinder.find_spec(name)
        return importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
            name, spec.origin, loader=self,
            submodule_search_locations=spec.submodule_search_locations,
        )
    def create_module(self, spec):
        return None
    def exec_module(self, module):
        return None

errors = []
hook = ImportHook()
sys.meta_path.insert(0, hook)
try:
    loader = PackageLoader("res")
    rendered = Environment(loader=loader).get_template("test.html").render().strip()
    print("custom_loader:", type(loader._loader).__name__, "rendered:", rendered)
    assert isinstance(loader._loader, ImportHook)
    assert loader._archive is None and rendered == "BAR"
except Exception as error:
    print("custom_loader_error:", type(error).__name__, str(error))
    errors.append(type(error).__name__)
finally:
    sys.meta_path.remove(hook)
    sys.modules.pop("res", None)

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("tests/res/package.zip").resolve()))
try:
    loader = PackageLoader("t_pack")
    rendered = Environment(loader=loader).get_template("foo/test.html").render().strip()
    print("zip_loader:", type(loader._loader).__name__, "rendered:", rendered)
    assert isinstance(loader._loader, zipimport.zipimporter)
    assert loader._archive is not None and rendered == "FOO"
except Exception as error:
    print("zip_loader_error:", type(error).__name__, str(error))
    errors.append(type(error).__name__)
assert not errors, errors
PYREPLAY
